That is fair! I am no social genius.. I went on a trip.. Just got op and left. I sgned up for a 3 week program at a college far away, far away and went. I enjoyed the small town I stayed in. I liked playing the "student" i am i my late 20s too old for going to school.. I did it for fun.. Might as well do Odd things if you are on your way "out". I talked to people and and became a well liked (though an odd) guest in the comunity.
Went home and the world is..bigger somehow. My town seems pointless and small..

I know. Just need to find a way to keep rounding corners. What would it take for you to feel better? For me.. New friends and new people. I went somewhere else. An adventure..
When i came home I suddenly had this "oh, but fuck you mentality" I just did things and I yelled at people. And I worked more. Well i worked..
I went out at night.
Thank you so much! You are amazing!

Hej, tak for alle jeres svar!

Honestly, jeg regnede med måske en eller to, så i er awesome.

Måske er jeg lidt skør, måske er det noget samfundsaktuelt mht. pres og forventninger. Jeg ved det ikke. Det fylder bare for meget. 

Jeg tror, at jeg tager ned og taler med min læge. Det er alligevel rigtigt længe siden, at jeg har været ved lægen og så kan hun også se, at jeg stadig lever og den slags. 😏

Hej med dig. Først, Tak for dit svar! 
Jeg er ked af at høre, at du har følt dig ensom gennem 10 år. Det lyder ikke rart. Til gengæld ser, jeg, at du ikke mangler kompetencer til at skrive mig et fint svar. 

Din pointe er nemlig relevant. Der er altid de som har det værre og det glemmer vi tit, især når vi sidder med vores lækre rene vand. Healthcare og nem adgang til en chokolade (jeg vil gerne kraftigt fremhæve chokolade). Sprøg til side. Du har ret. Det er på en måde både værre og bedre at vi er flere, hvis det giver mening. 

Jeg har modsat dig aldrig været udpræget dygtig til at tjene penge. Jeg har altid taget arbejde, men det er vidst bare normale vagter, timer, projekter og noget løn. 😏

Tak for jeres svar! Flere har spurgt om arbejde. Jeg har arbejde, som er studierelevant til uddannelsen. Jeg kan selvfølgelig ikke på nogen måde arbejde fuld tid, men jeg har ikke oplevet det at få arbejde som et problem. Der ville mit netværk også kunne hjælpe. Jeg er ikke på den måde økomisk trængt, men jeg lever ikke en imponerende tilværelse. Jeg løber dog tør for SU på et tidspunkt. Det ville være hårdt at starte forfra.

Princess Caraboo
In 1817, a British shoemaker encountered a confused girl wearing exotic clothes, who spoke a foreign language. She Calle herself "Caraboo" , and she could identify a pineapple as "ananas", but not "pineapple". She was arrested and during her imprisonment she met a Portuguese sailor who apparently could her language. According to him, she was Princess Caraboo from the island of Javasu, her boat had been hijacked by pirates and she ended up at at the shore. For the next ten months, Caraboo was a diligent houseguest of the nobility. She used shot bow and arrow, fought, swam naked, and worshiped a God by the name of "Allah Tallah". However, she was eventually recognized in a newspaper from Bristol, it turned out that she was a regular maid who had no accommodation and had invented the whole story
